api.critChance: FightEngine(random: Random(seed), critChance: critChance).resolve(...) as in resolve
api.resolve: FightEngine(random: Random(seed)).resolve(playerSide: players, monsterSide: monsters); each side lists runs [typeKey, side, maxHp, atk, def, isBoss, count], count Combatant(...) each, in order. out: winner, turnCount, initialMonsterCount, finalMonsterCount, the currentHp of every combatant of each side in order, and turns: per FightTurnSummary [attacksPlayed, critCount, damageDealtByPlayer, damageDealtByMonster, playerAliveAtEnd, monsterAliveAtEnd, playerHpAtEnd, monsterHpAtEnd]
api.twoFights: Two fights in a row on the same Random(seed), a new FightEngine for each, as a rehearsal plays them: out lists both results
